C_cw_rooke.name: Captain Imani Rooke
C_cw_rooke.role: commanding officer of RFV Crimson Warden; an Ember-lineage captain who treats authority as responsibility for costs she cannot personally absorb
C_cw_rooke.visualAnchor: Late-40s Black woman with deep-brown skin, short locs threaded with gray, steady dark eyes, broad cheekbones and a compact strong build. Mature Fleet command uniform: deep Fleet blue and Ion White with restrained gold rank hardware and narrow ember-crimson lineage bands; practical, immaculate, never theatrical.
C_cw_rooke.wardrobe: Command-deck uniform or dark emergency command layer over the same uniform; no cape, crown, ceremonial flame costume or fantasy armor.
C_cw_rooke.performance: Still, attentive and economical. She asks for the actual cost before committing. Under pressure her voice gets quieter, not louder; she allows informed dissent and then owns the decision.
C_cw_rooke.relationship: Neral is her operational counterweight, not a subordinate she silences. The deck and air crews know she remembers losses by name.
promptContinuity: Ember lineage is expressed through disciplined crimson accents and command culture, not literal flames everywhere.
Rooke must read as a working carrier captain, not an admiral or monarch.

C_cw_neral.name: Commander Dax Neral
C_cw_neral.role: Crimson Warden air-group commander who converts strategic needs into sorties flown by people he knows personally
C_cw_neral.visualAnchor: Early-40s man with olive skin, close-cut black hair going gray at the temples, long face, tired hazel eyes and a lean pilot's build. Fleet flight-operations uniform in dark blue with white collar tabs, restrained gold and a narrow crimson air-group stripe.
C_cw_neral.wardrobe: Flight-operations uniform, headset or slate on duty; pressure suit only when explicitly flying.
C_cw_neral.performance: Fast arithmetic, clipped phrasing, dry humor when the deck is healthy. Pushes back with numbers rather than speeches. He feels every launch as a promise the ship may fail to keep.
C_cw_neral.relationship: Can challenge Rooke directly in operations. Protective of Korr and Hart without becoming paternal.
promptContinuity: Do not make Neral a swaggering fighter ace; his present job is operational command.
Show fatigue accumulating across the issue.

C_cw_quill.name: Senior Chief Marta Quill
C_cw_quill.role: senior maintenance chief responsible for deciding which damaged craft are safe, salvageable or only technically flyable
C_cw_quill.visualAnchor: Late-50s woman with light brown skin, cropped silver hair, heavy forearms, lined face and magnifying work lenses usually pushed up on her forehead. Dark Fleet maintenance coveralls with Ion White tool markings, grease, abrasion and a small crimson Warden patch.
C_cw_quill.wardrobe: Worn maintenance coveralls, tool harness, hearing protection around flight operations.
C_cw_quill.performance: Blunt, exact and allergic to euphemism. She touches damaged machines while talking and names failures physically: cracked spar, cooked bus, bad actuator.
C_cw_quill.relationship: Korr trusts Quill's no-go calls. Neral sometimes needs more aircraft than Quill believes exist.
promptContinuity: Quill's hands and tools should look used, not pristine.
Maintenance spaces are crowded workplaces, not glossy hangars.

C_cw_korr.name: Lieutenant Commander Sena Korr
C_cw_korr.role: veteran strike-and-cover squadron leader; one of the pilots everyone asks to fly one more difficult sortie
C_cw_korr.visualAnchor: Late-30s woman with medium-brown skin, angular face, shaved right side with dark hair swept left, dark eyes and a rangy athletic build. Fleet pressure suit in blue-white with practical crimson squadron marks, helmet marked by wear rather than trophies.
C_cw_korr.wardrobe: Pressure suit for sorties; plain dark-blue shipboard layer in ready rooms.
C_cw_korr.performance: Controlled, unsentimental and intensely spatial. She jokes only when she wants somebody else to unclench. She never treats younger pilots as expendable.
C_cw_korr.relationship: Hart is assigned to her element. She respects Neral but will tell him when he is spending aircraft faster than Quill can return them.
promptContinuity: Keep Korr professional rather than invulnerable.
Her flying is readable as decisions in space, not abstract speed streaks.

C_cw_hart.name: Ensign Milo Hart
C_cw_hart.role: newly assigned carrier pilot on his first live convoy-support rotation aboard Crimson Warden
C_cw_hart.visualAnchor: Early-20s man with tan skin, thick dark-brown curls, open face, gray-blue eyes and a lean young build. Newer Fleet pressure suit with clean blue-white panels and a narrow crimson squadron identifier; helmet and gear noticeably less worn than Korr's.
C_cw_hart.wardrobe: New pressure suit for flight; simple Academy-to-fleet transfer fatigues off duty.
C_cw_hart.performance: Quick, capable and trying not to sound impressed by the carrier. Talks a little too much when frightened, then gets very quiet once the problem becomes concrete.
C_cw_hart.relationship: Looks to Korr for operational cues and Quill for the unromantic truth about whether his aircraft is safe.
promptContinuity: Do not play Hart as incompetent; he is inexperienced, not foolish.
His gear gradually acquires scuffs and damage during the issue.

C_cw_malk.name: Lieutenant Rhea Malk
C_cw_malk.role: flight-deck control officer who sequences launches, traps, deck crews and emergency clearing under seconds-level pressure
C_cw_malk.visualAnchor: Mid-30s South Asian woman with warm brown skin, black hair braided tight to the scalp, sharp dark eyes and compact athletic posture. Dark deck-control suit with Ion White visibility panels, crimson armband, hearing protection and hand-signal gloves.
C_cw_malk.wardrobe: Flight-deck control gear with headset, gloves and safety tether; sealed emergency hood only during pressure loss.
C_cw_malk.performance: Counts in short phrases, points before she speaks and keeps her eyes on moving hardware. Anger appears as increased precision.
C_cw_malk.relationship: Cal is one of her most reliable deck techs. Quill and Malk argue over when a damaged airframe stops being a deck problem and becomes a maintenance problem.
promptContinuity: Keep deck choreography spatially consistent around Malk.
She is an officer doing hands-on deck control, not a bridge commander.

C_cw_nyr.name: Dr. Vessa Nyr
C_cw_nyr.role: chief medical officer responsible for flight medicine, mass-casualty triage and deciding when a pilot is no longer medically fit to launch
C_cw_nyr.visualAnchor: Mid-40s East Asian woman with pale olive skin, shoulder-length black hair tied back, rectangular medical optics and a calm round face. Ion White medical layer over Fleet blue utility uniform with restrained crimson ship marking.
C_cw_nyr.wardrobe: Medical utility uniform, gloves and compact trauma harness during alerts.
C_cw_nyr.performance: Direct, gentle and difficult to hurry past a medical fact. Uses first names when someone is scared and surnames when she needs them to listen.
C_cw_nyr.relationship: Neral wants pilots; Nyr decides whether there are still people inside the suits who can safely be pilots.
promptContinuity: Medical scenes are practical workplaces, not gore displays.
Nyr's calm should not read as emotional detachment.

C_cw_shaw.name: Lieutenant Toren Shaw
C_cw_shaw.role: recovery and rescue pilot who flies the unglamorous craft sent toward damaged ships, ejected pilots and unstable debris
C_cw_shaw.visualAnchor: Mid-30s man with dark skin, shaved head, narrow mustache, long arms and a relaxed posture that becomes intensely focused at controls. Heavy rescue-flight suit in Fleet blue and white with high-visibility crimson rescue tabs.
C_cw_shaw.wardrobe: Rescue pressure suit and helmet in craft; utility layer between sorties.
C_cw_shaw.performance: Low-key, methodical and almost impossible to bait into rushing. Talks continuously to survivors during pickup because silence makes panic worse.
C_cw_shaw.relationship: Malk trusts his timing on an obstructed deck. Korr trusts him to come after a downed pilot even when she cannot.
promptContinuity: Rescue craft is workmanlike and visibly different from fighters.
Shaw's heroism is procedural, not posed.

C_cw_cal.name: Petty Officer Renn Cal
C_cw_cal.role: young flight-deck technician assigned to launch and recovery crews
C_cw_cal.visualAnchor: Late-20s white man with sandy hair shaved close, freckled face, compact build and an old burn mark across one glove cuff. Dark deck suit with Ion White visibility blocks, crimson Warden patch, hearing protection and tool clips.
C_cw_cal.wardrobe: Flight-deck safety gear; off shift, plain crew fatigues and a battered gray coffee mug.
C_cw_cal.performance: Fast hands, casual complaints and good situational awareness. Uses jokes to keep the deck human without treating risk as trivial.
C_cw_cal.relationship: Malk relies on him. Quill knows him as the technician who actually writes down recurring faults instead of just resetting them.
promptContinuity: Establish Cal and his gray coffee mug early enough that later absence has weight.
Never romanticize his injury or death.
